# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_CONFIRMATION_FILTER_RIBBON_RIDE_P

**Filed:** 2026-07-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a volume confirmation requirement (breakdown bar volume > 20-bar average volume) to the ribbon_ride P (BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON) entries will improve fill rate by ensuring we only enter on bars with strong volume confirmation, thus reducing slippage and improving the quality of fills, without significantly increasing missed opportunity on the J winner days.

## Mechanism

We will add a new context filter to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup: 
- The breakdown bar (the trigger bar that meets ≥2 of the 3 trigger conditions: level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence with multi-day or premarket structure) must have volume greater than the 20-bar average volume (calculated on the 5-minute chart, using the 20 bars prior to the current bar).
This filter is applied in addition to the existing context filters (time of day, SPY structure, EMA ribbon bearish, no major news, daily loss budget, ribbon spread ≥30 cents, no volume divergence on the breakdown bar, VIX confirmation, and J's availability).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure #1).
2. **Sample bias:** Testing only on the 6 J anchor days (n=6), which are highly selected for being the engine's best/worst days per OP-16. High overfit risk due to small sample size and selection method (anchor days only).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window tested yet).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real-fills check on top 3 J days performed yet).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Potential to miss all entries on a winner day (e.g., 5/04) if breakdown bar volume fails the filter, turning a large winner into a zero.
   - Max drawdown: Could increase if we skip winners and take losers that randomly pass the volume filter.
   - Blow-up scenario: If volume calculation is faulty (e.g., using look-ahead bias), we might enter on low-volume breakdown bars that are prone to failure, but this is mitigated by using prior-bar volume average.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
- Gym validators must pass for the modified entry logic.
- Walk-forward test must show non-degrading performance (WF ratio ≥ 0.70) on an OOS window.
- Real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) must show fill rate improvement without increasing slippage > ±20% vs BS sim.
- Anchor no-regression: Must not regress on any J winner day (engine MUST still take them) and must not increase losses on J loser days beyond current engine behavior.
